claims.statement: Deterministic polynomial-time black-box PIT for general polynomial-degree commutative arithmetic circuits in characteristic zero.
Total derivative dimension equals shuffle-Hankel rank, minimum linear automaton dimension, logarithmic branch-span dimension and minimum rational homogeneous ODE/system dimension.
A rational function of the selected independent logarithms is D-finite over C(z) exactly when the rational function is a polynomial.
Symmetric squarefree lifting has exact 2^n linear-state complexity and a (1-epsilon^2)*binomial(n,floor(n/2)) degree-n relative-l2 approximation lower bound.
Fixed-order sorted lifting has exponential linear-state examples; a regular multiplicative section of abelianization does not exist for n>=2.
Polynomial-size explicit scalar hitting sets for small total derivative-span dimension.
An explicit uniform polynomial B(n,s,D) bounding logarithmic contact for every nonzero size-s degree-D commutative circuit would yield polynomial-size scalar hitting sets.
No rational map of degree >1 has R^{-1}(S) contained in S when |S|>=3; this blocks fixed-alphabet ramified logarithmic pullback amplification.
Standard-library integer/Fraction checks cover 8 Hankel minors, 27 cut matrices, 10 translation models, 5 shuffle identities, 4 contact examples and 18 hitting-generator fixtures.
